ابتسرتا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَسَرَتَا (ibtasaratā) /ib.ta.sa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# اُبْتُسِرَتَا (ubtusiratā) /ub.tu.si.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
